capabilities: render the vault link graph as a rotating 3D galaxy
navigate the graph by dragging, zooming, hovering and clicking nodes
embed a live orrery view in a note via a code block
filter the graph to a single folder
customize colors, bloom, node size, rotation and backdrop layers
extras: The README mentions the author's unrelated app parry, a mobile AI messaging app; it is not related to this plugin.
motivation: The author built it to make the vault look incredible, while also showing which notes are hubs, how folders cluster, and what is isolated.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is a flat 2D force layout, so there is no cinematic, spatially immersive way to see the vault's link structure.
summary: 3D graph view that renders the vault's link graph as an auto-rotating galaxy with bloom-lit nodes, nebula and starfield backdrops.
